name: Returning Home
summary: In Goldshire, a novice night elf priest hears an urgent call from Darnassus. Priestess Josetta carries the message: return to the Temple of the Moon and continue training under Priestess Alathea.

sections.title: A Word in Goldshire
sections.body: Night elves are rare in Elwynn Forest, and a young acolyte among its human settlements draws attention. When you reach Goldshire, Priestess Josetta greets you with news. A Sister of Elune has traveled across continents seeking you, bearing an urgent command from the Temple of the Moon. Your calling now leads back to Kalimdor, where your training can advance.

sections.title: The Call of the Temple
sections.body: Darnassus looks to the Temple of the Moon for night elf faith and leadership. Priestess Alathea and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind oversee the Sisterhood’s instruction, keeping watch over disciples even when curiosity carries them overseas. When you return, the priestesses welcome you with motherly concern. Then they begin your deeper studies of the Moon Goddess’s celestial mysteries.

faq.q: Why is a night elf priest being summoned from human lands?
faq.answer: Young night elf priests who travel to the Eastern Kingdoms remain bound to their sacred order in Teldrassil. Priestess Alathea follows their progress and calls them back to the Temple of the Moon when they are ready to learn higher rites of Elune.

Priestess Josetta is the human priest trainer at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. She serves the Holy Light and respects visiting kaldorei acolytes, helping emissaries from Darnassus reach their wayward kin.

Priestess Alathea is a senior Sister of Elune who trains acolytes at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She works with High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind to watch novice night elf priests’ growth and spiritual dedication.

faq.q: What happens after returning to Darnassus?
faq.answer: When you report to Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon, she welcomes you home and gives you your next task, Stars of Elune. There, you explore the sacred power granted by the goddess.

faq.q: How does this differ from the normal training path?
faq.answer: This alternate path guides night elf priests who choose to train in human lands such as Elwynn Forest back to their racial trainers in Darnassus. There, they can learn their race-specific priestly abilities.

faq.q: How did the messenger find an acolyte all the way in Elwynn Forest?
aliases: how did they know i was here
faq.answer: A Sister of Elune travels from Darnassus to the Eastern Kingdoms and leaves word with Alliance trainers such as Priestess Josetta in Goldshire. Josetta watches for the traveling novice and directs them home.

angles.text: Every priest order has deep roots in tradition. As a kaldorei acolyte, you advance in the lunar rites only with senior priestesses’ approval at the Temple of the Moon.
As a night elf, you may travel far across the sea to the lands of the younger races, but Teldrassil and Elune’s blessings draw you back to your sacred sanctuaries.

As an Alliance member, you see growing cooperation between the Church of the Holy Light in Elwynn and the Sisterhood of Elune in Darnassus. Their hospitality strengthens the bonds between Alliance races.
